name: Geometric Extremum Constraint Translation
description: Replaces a bitwise arithmetic target that trivially implies bipartiteness with the sum of dot products of 4D calibration vectors. The vectors are chosen such that monochromatic edges yield a large positive scalar (30) and bichromatic edges yield a small negative scalar (-4). The global target is set to the absolute minimum (-4m). To solve the problem, the model must independently compute the pairwise dot products and deduce that the global target can only be met if every single edge achieves this minimum.
